FEAT-2-S150.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contracts
FEAT-2-S150.description: Define Pydantic models and internal contracts for specialty identification inputs and outputs, including normalized query text, extracted specialty tokens, NUCC code list, and confidence scores.

FEAT-2-S151.title: Unit Tests for Specialty Identification Logic
FEAT-2-S151.description: Create unit tests covering regex extraction, vector matching, NUCC mapping, deduplication, and confidence scoring, including edge cases such as ambiguous or multi-specialty queries.
FEAT-2-S151.evidence: GAP: No existing specialty-specific test file; must be created under backend/tests to validate specialty_service behavior.

FEAT-2-S152.title: Integrate Specialty Identification with Provider Search
FEAT-2-S152.description: Integrate specialty identification output into provider search service, ensuring NUCC codes are correctly passed into taxonomy fallback and vector search filtering.
